name: LaTeX
description: LaTeX is the gold standard for technical and scientific document preparation. It is essential for academic papers, theses, and any document requiring precise mathematical typesetting, cross-references, and bibliographies.

items.title: LaTeX Wikibook
items.description: A comprehensive free textbook covering everything from installation to advanced packages, math typesetting, and bibliography management.

items.title: Learn LaTeX in 30 Minutes (Overleaf)
items.description: A beginner-friendly quick start guide that gets you writing LaTeX in under an hour.

items.title: LaTeX Project Documentation
items.description: Official LaTeX documentation including guides, manuals, and beginner tutorials.

items.title: Overleaf Documentation
items.description: Extensive documentation and tutorials by Overleaf covering LaTeX basics and advanced topics.

items.title: CTAN (Comprehensive TeX Archive)
items.description: The definitive archive of all LaTeX packages and documentation.

items.title: Overleaf Tutorials
items.description: Interactive tutorials that teach LaTeX through hands-on document editing in the browser.

items.title: LaTeX Tutorials (YouTube)
items.description: Thousands of free video tutorials covering LaTeX from basics to advanced document design.

items.title: LaTeX Full Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A comprehensive multi-hour LaTeX course covering math, figures, bibliographies, and presentations.

items.title: Overleaf
items.description: The most popular online LaTeX editor with collaborative editing, templates, and instant preview.

items.title: LaTeX Cheatsheet
items.description: A concise one-page reference for common LaTeX commands, math symbols, and environments.

items.title: LaTeX Math Symbols
items.description: Complete reference of all LaTeX math mode symbols.

items.title: LaTeX Project Blog
items.description: Official LaTeX project news and release announcements.

items.title: TeX StackExchange
items.description: Q&A platform for LaTeX and TeX related questions.

items.title: Reddit r/LaTeX
items.description: Community for LaTeX discussions, templates, and troubleshooting.

items.title: TeX StackExchange
items.description: The definitive Q&A platform for LaTeX typesetting problems.
